summary: The narrow strip of icon buttons along the edge of the sidebar used to switch between its panels.
description: Sidebar launcher strip with expanded and collapsed states that provides entry points to various sidebar panels and sidebar extensions, plus bottom actions like "Customize sidebar". Default export SidebarMain, registered as custom element sidebar-main.

attributes.name: expanded
attributes.description: Reflected attribute; whether the launcher strip is in its expanded (labelled, vertical-tabs) state versus collapsed icon-only state.

attributes.name: selectedView
attributes.description: The view id of the currently selected/open sidebar panel; initialized from window.SidebarController.currentID.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the sidebar is currently open; initialized from window.SidebarController.isOpen.

attributes.name: bottomActions
attributes.description: Internal list of bottom action entries (e.g. "Customize sidebar"), populated by setCustomize().

attributes.name: sidebarItems
attributes.description: Declared in static properties but not read or written anywhere else in the file; appears to be unused/vestigial in the current implementation.

attributes.name: shouldShowOverflowButton
attributes.description: Internal computed state controlling visibility of the tools overflow ("more tools") button.

attributes.name: isOverflowMenuOpen
attributes.description: Internal state tracking whether the tools overflow popup menu is open.

slots.name: tabstrip
slots.description: Slot for the tab strip content (used in vertical-tabs mode).

events.name: sidebar-contextmenu-ready
events.description: Dispatched on the host after the sidebar context menu has finished being populated asynchronously (see onSidebarPopupShowing).
